paite: Ngai in, unaute kituak diamdiam a omkhawm anak hoih in, anuam mahmah hi!
heading: David La / Unau Ki-itna Phatna

paite: Lu a thau manphatak, khamul a luangkhia, Aaron khamul ngei a luangkhia a, apuanaktual mong a luangkhia bang ahi.
Hermon daitui chiim Zion tangte a ke zel bang ahi; huai ah ToUPA'N vualzawlna thu apia a, tangtawn a hinna ding ngei.
